summary: Revalidated ABB's sponsored ADR against issuer-published Q2 2026 results, current issuer listing data, and the 2026-07-27 market and FX caches. Record orders, a 20.2% operational EBITA margin, strong cash conversion, low leverage, and adequate paper-monitoring liquidity support baseline eligibility. The Robotics disposal removes the direct embodied-AI exposure while the proposed Rotork acquisition adds capital-allocation and integration risk. At the USD 96.97 mark, bounded 12-month EPS scenarios imply 33.2% downside and 11.9% base-case downside. ABB remains watching with medium confidence; no conviction strategy was enqueued because the base case is below market, the margin-of-safety and timing gates fail, and the causal relationship remains pending.
